pageDescription: Inference spend, platform fees, credits, and live quota windows.
selectCompany: Select a company to view costs.
selectDateRange: Select a start and end date to load data.

budgetConsumedPercent: {{percent}}% of monthly budget consumed in this range.

financeLedgerDescription: Account-level charges that do not map to a single inference request.

pendingApprovalsSubtitle: Budget override approvals awaiting board action

projectBudgetDescription: Lifetime spend policies for execution-bound projects.

financialEventMixDescription: Account-level charges grouped by event kind.
noFinanceEventsInPeriod: No finance events in this period.
recentFinancialEventsDescription: Top-ups, fees, credits, commitments, and other non-request charges.
noFinancialEventsInPeriod: No financial events in this period.
accountingModelDescription: Paperclip now separates request-level inference usage from account-level finance events. That keeps provider reporting honest when the biller is OpenRouter, Cloudflare, Bedrock, or another intermediary.
inferenceLedgerSurfaceDescription: Request-scoped usage and billed runs from cost_events.
financeLedgerSurfaceDescription: Account-level charges that are not one prompt-response pair.
liveQuotasDescription: Provider or biller windows that can stop traffic in real time.
